project.name: Native DOM, AST and events
project.description: Compare retained JSON and owned binary projection-source commands, passive event records, native structural conversions and exact exports with explicit source ownership and read-only binary resources.

entries.name: Validate original CEM-ML source
entries.description: Validate the original source before creating projections; this is not validation of an exported AST or DOM record.

entries.name: Validate original XML source
entries.description: Check XML well-formedness independently from importing its retained structural view.

entries.name: Parse original CEM AST
entries.description: Present the original native source nodes and source-frame ranges as CEM-ML text. No JSON AST handoff is used.

entries.name: Parse original CEM EVENTS
entries.description: Present the original native source ordered lexical events, trivia and byte ranges as CEM-ML text. No JSON AST handoff is used.

entries.name: Format original XML
entries.description: Publish exact native writer bytes and original source ranges; select Results → Provenance to return to the owned input.

entries.name: Render CEM as HTML
entries.description: Publish exact native writer bytes and original source ranges; select Results → Provenance to return to the owned input.

entries.name: Render CEM as XML
entries.description: Publish exact native writer bytes and original source ranges; select Results → Provenance to return to the owned input.

entries.name: Inspect retained XML structure
entries.description: Inspect the shared imported CEM tree, retaining XML namespace, comments, CDATA and original byte/line positions. This differs from parsing a serialized projection artifact.

entries.name: Inspect an owned plain-text resource
entries.description: Inspect native text/plain import as one retained text node with its original buffer. This family has no registered schema package or generic source-validation claim.

entries.name: Export explicit DOM JSON
entries.description: Request a named JSON debug export from the original native source. The exported byteRange/sourceMap fields are data; revalidating them does not restore the original source owner.

entries.name: Export native DOM binary bytes
entries.description: Request exact native binary projection bytes from the original source for download. Binary source execution requires an explicitly selected saved configuration and native byte admission.

entries.name: Export explicit AST JSON
entries.description: Export the native semantic AST as a registered document object with namespaces, text data, reference edges, original ranges and source maps.

entries.name: Export native AST binary bytes
entries.description: Request exact native binary projection bytes from the original source for download. Binary source execution requires an explicitly selected saved configuration and native byte admission.

entries.name: Export explicit EVENTS JSON
entries.description: Request a named JSON debug export from the original native source. The exported byteRange/sourceMap fields are data; revalidating them does not restore the original source owner.

entries.name: Export native EVENTS binary bytes
entries.description: Request exact native binary projection bytes from the original source for download. Binary source execution requires an explicitly selected saved configuration and native byte admission.

entries.name: Validate DOM JSON source shape
entries.description: Validate the native JSON debug export using the registered projection source validator. This checks its supported shape and grants no decoded runtime import or source ownership.

entries.name: Repair the DOM JSON kind
entries.description: Restore the supported document root kind after the original native projection-shape diagnostic. Native JSON projection diagnostics currently have null text coordinates.

entries.name: Validate AST JSON source shape
entries.description: Validate the separate authored document-object AST fixture using the registered projection source validator. This checks its supported shape and grants no decoded runtime import or source ownership.

entries.name: Repair the AST JSON kind
entries.description: Restore the supported document root kind after the original native projection-shape diagnostic. Native JSON projection diagnostics currently have null text coordinates.

entries.name: Validate EVENTS JSON source shape
entries.description: Validate the native JSON debug export using the registered projection source validator. This checks its supported shape and grants no decoded runtime import or source ownership.

entries.name: Repair the EVENTS JSON kind
entries.description: Restore the supported open event kind after the original native projection-shape diagnostic. Native JSON projection diagnostics currently have null text coordinates.

entries.name: Repair the original CEM closing brace
entries.description: Review all three original native unclosed-scope diagnostics, including the tokenizer EOF byte/UTF-16 boundary, then restore the missing outer closing brace.

entries.name: Validate the native AST JSON export
entries.description: Validate the actual native semantic document export without wrapping or reshaping it. Source-shape validation grants no executable replay, native owner or original-source navigation authority.

entries.name: Parse imported DOM JSON
entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.name: Inspect imported AST JSON
entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.name: Inspect imported event records
entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.name: Convert imported AST to XML
entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.name: Present imported event records as CEM
entries.description: Import original projection bytes through the shared native boundary. Reported source maps and runtime IDs remain passive data; source navigation addresses this JSON artifact.

entries.name: Parse owned DOM binary
entries.description: Run the explicit persisted configuration against exact owned binary bytes after native input admission. The source stays read-only; no executable stream replay or text reinterpretation is allowed.
